literal_meaning: বক পাখির এক প্রজাতি (heron or egret-like bird)
figurative_meaning_en: Insignificant or lowly people in a sarcastic or dismissive sense
example_sentences_in_bangla: এরা সব কাগা-বগা লোক, কোনো গুরুত্ব দেওয়ার নয়।
example_sentences_in_english: These are all riff-raff, not worth paying attention to.
The meeting is full of hoi polloi.
note: Often used in conjunction with 'কাগা' to form 'কাগা-বগা' for emphasizing common or insignificant folk in Bengali vernacular.
